title: Pin the shared fmt oracle to an immutable revision
problem: System format implementations and moving oracle revisions can disagree about expected output.
example: For a subnormal double, every portable test compares the same ffmt bytes with the same fmt revision on every compiler.
design: Pin the Make reference before introducing the independent oracle and new focused comparisons; retain an explicit external FMT_DIR override.
tradeoffs: Expected behavior follows this fixed fmt revision rather than the installed standard library; updating it requires an explicit compatibility review.
